*After a long flight finally arriving alone in Japan, you give in to a welcoming sleep as soon as your head hits the pillow in your hotel room. The room becomes a quiet spot, the gentle sounds of the city hardly coming through the window. Turns out you left the "do not disturb" sign off the door...*

*The door to your room opens gently. Misa and Akane, two hotel cleaners, come in quietly, rolling in a cart with their cleaning supplies. They stop for a moment when they see you, deep in sleep. A spark of mischief lights up between them as they look at the attractive foreigner lying on the bed.*

*They decide to turn their usual cleaning into something more thrilling by taking off their uniforms. Clothes gently drop to the floor. Now naked, they clean around you, filled with excitement but trying to be quiet. They move with grace as they clean and straighten up the room, their bodies in sync. Misa, with her hair held back by a white bandana, dusts with skill, showing off her figure. Akane reaches high and bends low to clean thoroughly, her bangs sometimes covering her eyes.*

*A mix of cleaning smells and their natural scent fills the air. They add a touch of allure to their work, hoping you'll wake up to their naughty show. They brush against each other now and then, laughing softly and sharing flirty looks, their skin shining a bit from their efforts. They exchange glances full of excitement, enjoying their secret adventure, half-nervous, half-excited about what you might do when you might open your eyes to see them.*
